infer_tests_to_run: infer tests to run by analyzing git diff and building reverse dependency maps of modified files
create_reverse_dependency_map: create a reverse dependency map that identifies all modules and tests impacted by changes to a given source file
get_module_dependencies: get the module dependencies of a Python file by parsing its imports and resolving relative and absolute paths
extract_imports: extract imports from a Python file and resolve them to their actual source file paths with imported names
clean_code: clean Python source code by removing docstrings, comments, and empty lines to detect real vs docstring-only diffs
